purpose: Attest actual executing definitions and source-read setting origin without changing original strategy decisions; missing witness stays UNKNOWN
authority: Separate explicit production code approval, then separate deployment/restart/activation authorization; this document grants none

fields.runtime_UUID: Fresh random immutable identifier for each interpreter/application incarnation; not an alias for derived OS fingerprint; no old PID reuse
fields.derived_runtime_fingerprint: External OS tuple as secondary link, with its stated limits
fields.source_manifest_hash: Versioned disk/build manifest; distinct from loaded-code manifest
fields.loaded_module_file_code_fingerprint: Allowlisted actual module/class/function references used by gate, scorer, adapter and Pilot; module origin/spec/loader plus bounded recursive code fingerprint; never substitute compile(current disk) for live __code__
fields.process_start: Observed OS ticks/boot ID and existing bot-start marker separately; missing exact import time null
fields.config_origin_revision: Per allowed field source-default/env/DB/startup/admin provenance; immutable load and mutation records; completeness flags
fields.Pilot_generation: Actual read, not inferred; distinct from complete four-field observer revision
fields.decision_ms: Reuse existing adapter347 value exactly; no clock call added
fields.receipt_observer_version: Pinned observer implementation/source hash; currently NOT_IMPLEMENTED
fields.restore_DB_generation: Independently bound DB lineage/restore identifier; null/UNKNOWN until exact evidence, never inode/path/staging UUID
fields.startup_load_receipt: Loaded source plus four actual values/origins/revision and runtime namespace; retrospective start cannot be fabricated
fields.decision_sequence: Per runtime observer allocation; never legacy signal_id alone
fields.source_read_witnesses: Bind cap gate, threshold reads, cfg qualification/storage/event readings to actual invocation; post-hoc equality insufficient
fields.feature_payload: 16 bounded primitive feature fields; invalid/missing preserved; no future enrichment
fields.loss_and_integrity: Prior hash/sequence/ACK reference; pending/gaps/oversize/overflow/crash tail explicitly UNKNOWN

required_observation_boundaries: Startup after actual load: capture references and values without re-running selector or constructing another Pilot
Every allowed startup/admin publication path: observe actual values/origin/revision without joining source DB transaction; failure/loss invalidates completeness
Actual pre-arm gate cap read and score threshold reads: immutable runtime proof or per-read witness required
Existing decision_ms and actual selector result: bounded observe; all branch failures remain source-identical
Restore and interpreter restart: new namespace and provenance; absent restore capability means UNKNOWN

atomicity_contract.if_exact_needs_behavior_change: Reject exact acceptance and separately redesign; do not silently add coordination
atomicity_contract.feasibility_status: NOT_CERTIFIED; requirements complete but implementation/owner proof pending

noninterference.strategy_failure_policy: FAIL_OPEN; original return, exceptions, SQL commits, notifications, queue, entry/exit remain identical
noninterference.evidence_failure_policy: FAIL_CLOSED; no exact classification when bounds/origin/loaded definitions/revision/ACK are incomplete
noninterference.failures: Observer errors must never leak into strategy handlers, rollback source writes, retry selector, suppress notify or duplicate entry

bounded_append_only.sink: Separately approved off-path create-only append ledger; no production DB table
bounded_append_only.oversize_overflow: Explicit loss control when possible; otherwise missing/unACK tail UNKNOWN; no silent truncation
bounded_append_only.independent_anchor: Required for full stream/restore completeness; provider not chosen or provisioned
bounded_append_only.rotation_quota_retention: Must be frozen in separate disabled design; no operational readiness claim
bounded_append_only.watermark: Parent10s worker requirement; no new strategy clock; worker cadence not implemented here

secrets: Exact identity and allowed numeric strategy fields only; no environment dump, credentials, chat IDs, unbounded repr or exception strings
rollback: Disable admission without modifying strategy; off-path drain bounded by separately frozen budget; preserve old segments; unresolved tail UNKNOWN; no automatic restart
acceptance_gates_not_executed: OFF/ON deterministic source transcript across every existing branch
